Eight functions and methods in `django/` call `get_random_string` directly. I found them by searching for every use of the name and then checking which function or method each call sits in.

- `django/core/files/storage/base.py`: `Storage.get_alternative_name`, which adds a random 7-character suffix to a file name.
- `django/core/management/utils.py`: `get_random_secret_key`.
- `django/db/backends/oracle/creation.py`: `DatabaseCreation._test_database_passwd`, which generates a 30-character password for the test database.
- `django/middleware/csrf.py`: `_get_new_csrf_string`.
- `django/contrib/auth/hashers.py`: three callers.
  - `verify_password`
  - `make_password`, for the unusable-password suffix.
  - `BasePasswordHasher.salt`
- `django/contrib/sessions/backends/base.py`: `SessionBase._get_new_session_key`, which calls it twice.

`django/utils/crypto.py` only defines the function, so it isn't counted.
